title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
Part 1 of 5 is in. Base event shape, `EventType`, and the serialized DOM node types are exported from `@rewind/shared`, with TSDoc and `expectTypeOf` coverage in `packages/shared/src/types/types.test.ts`.

Checks on `232a0d7`: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` all passed.

Left open: parts 2–5 (event payloads, `parseEvent`, factory and guards, session-format docs). This PR stays a draft. Definition of done for the whole issue is not met yet.
